title: Abu Ubaidah's Trustworthiness
paragraphs: Known widely for his integrity, Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah was once described as the trustworthy one of this community, a title given after he consistently handled shared resources with complete honesty.

During a difficult expedition where food supplies were extremely limited, he distributed the remaining provisions fairly among the group, taking no more for himself despite holding a position of authority.
Companions who traveled with him during hardship often mentioned that his fairness never wavered, regardless of whether anyone was watching his decisions or checking his distribution of resources.
Leaders today studying his example often note that trustworthiness, especially during scarcity, reveals a person's true character more clearly than behavior during times of comfort and abundance.
